hook: His boat sank. Then his life raft started filling up.
narration: His fishing boat sank off Alaska. [short pause] Then his life raft started taking on water.
A Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Air Station Sitka flew out to him, about two miles east of Murder Cove.
In a hoist, the pilots can't see straight down. The flight mechanic in the open door talks them into place, foot by foot.
outcome: The Sitka aircrew hoisted the boater aboard the Jayhawk.
title: His boat sank, then his raft flooded
description:
A fishing vessel sank near Murder Cove on Admiralty Island, Alaska, and the boater's life raft began taking on water. A Coast Guard Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew hoisted him on Sept. 28, 2026.
